en: Our shop will close at the end of this month.
why: {今月|こんげつ}{末|まつ} is one time word, をもって follows it, and {閉店|へいてん} goes before いたします.

en: Starting with the Tokyo show, they will do a national tour.
why: {東京|とうきょう}{公演|こうえん} is one noun before を{皮切|かわき}りに, and {全国|ぜんこく} goes with ツアー.

before: {家族|かぞく}は{皆|みな}{反対|はんたい}で、
en: My whole family is against it, and my father won't even speak to me.
why: に{至|いた}っては follows {父|ちち}, and {口|くち}もきいてくれない is a set phrase.

after: {海外|かいがい}へ{旅立|たびだ}った。
en: Ignoring his parents' worry, he set off abroad alone.
why: {親|おや}の modifies {心配|しんぱい}, then をよそに, then the rest of the action.

before: {大企業|だいきぎょう}の{社長|しゃちょう}
en: When you become president of a big company, you probably have almost no free time.
why: ともなると follows the noun, and {自由|じゆう}な modifies {時間|じかん}.

before: {試験|しけん}まであと{一週間|いっしゅうかん}だ。
en: One week until the exam. I can't waste even a single day.
why: たりとも follows {一日|いちにち}, and {無駄|むだ}にはできない is one phrase.

en: This is a taste you can only find in Kyoto.
why: The pattern is noun + ならではの + noun.

before: {人気|にんき}{歌手|かしゅ}が{来|く}る
en: Because a popular singer was coming, the hall was overflowing with young people.
why: とあって follows the plain verb, then {会場|かいじょう}は is the topic of {若者|わかもの}であふれていた.

en: I came to greet you and also to thank you for the other day.
why: かたがた follows お{礼|れい}, and ご{挨拶|あいさつ}に{伺|うかが}う is the purpose phrase.

en: Besides working at a company, he writes novels.
why: {会社|かいしゃ}に needs {勤|つと}める, かたわら follows it, and {書|か}いて comes before いる.

en: While out on a walk, I dropped by the bookshop in front of the station.
why: がてら follows {散歩|さんぽ}, {駅前|えきまえ}の modifies {本屋|ほんや}, and {寄|よ}って comes before みた.

en: The moment he got home, he collapsed onto the bed.
why: {家|いえ}に needs {帰|かえ}る, and the pattern is verb + や{否|いな}や.

after: {教室|きょうしつ}を{飛|と}び{出|だ}した。
en: As soon as the bell rang, the children rushed out of the classroom.
why: ベルが needs {鳴|な}る, and the pattern is verb + が{早|はや}いか.

en: I forget words as soon as I learn them.
why: そばから follows {習|なら}った, and {忘|わす}れてしまう is one verb.

before: {彼女|かのじょ}は{部屋|へや}に
en: As soon as she entered the room, she burst out crying loudly.
why: {部屋|へや}に needs {入|はい}る, なり follows it, and {泣|な}き joins {出|だ}した.

before: {被害者|ひがいしゃ}の{話|はなし}を{聞|き}いて、
en: Hearing the victim's story, I couldn't help feeling anger toward the criminal.
why: {犯人|はんにん}への modifies {怒|いか}り, and the pattern is noun + を{禁|きん}じ{得|え}ない.

before: {皆様|みなさま}のご{活躍|かつやく}を
en: I sincerely wish you all success.
why: {心|こころ}より is a set phrase, and the pattern is て-form + やまない.

en: Talking loudly on the train is extremely annoying.
why: {大声|おおごえ}で modifies {話|はな}す, のは makes it the topic, and {迷惑|めいわく} goes before {極|きわ}まりない.

en: He is a person worthy of trust.
why: The pattern is noun + に{足|た}る + noun.

before: {最近|さいきん}のテレビ{番組|ばんぐみ}には
en: Many TV shows these days are unbearable to watch.
why: The pattern is verb + に{堪|た}えない, which then modifies もの.

en: His speech never fails to move those who hear it.
why: {聞|き}く{人|ひと}を is the object of {感動|かんどう}させ, and ずにはおかない follows the ない-stem.

before: {人|ひと}の{物|もの}を{壊|こわ}したのだから、
en: You broke someone's things, so you will have to pay for them.
why: {弁償|べんしょう}し is the verb, and the pattern is ないではすまない.

before: そんな{簡単|かんたん}なことは、
en: There's no need to ask the teacher something that simple.
why: {先生|せんせい}に goes with {聞|き}く, and the pattern is verb + までもない.

en: It's a light injury, so there's no need to go to the hospital.
why: {病院|びょういん}へ{行|い}く is one phrase, and the pattern is verb + には{及|およ}ばない.

before: もっと{早|はや}く{相談|そうだん}
en: If only you had talked to me sooner, I would have helped you.
why: {相談|そうだん}してくれれば is the condition, and ものを follows the result {助|たす}けた.

en: Even though it's spring, it often gets cold in the mornings and evenings.
why: とはいえ follows {春|はる}, then {朝晩|あさばん}は{冷|ひ}え{込|こ}む is the clause before こと.

en: Even an expert sometimes fails.
why: といえども follows the noun, and ことはある follows the plain verb.

en: It's small, but it's a room that gets good sunlight.
why: ながらも follows {狭|せま}い, and {日当|ひあ}たりのいい modifies {部屋|へや}.

en: Whatever the reason, violence is not allowed.
why: {理由|りゆう}が{何|なん}であれ is the set phrase, then the main clause.

before: {生徒|せいと}を{殴|なぐ}るなど、
en: Hitting a student is behavior unacceptable for a teacher.
why: The pattern is noun + にあるまじき + noun.

en: To become a doctor, I am aiming for medical school.
why: {医者|いしゃ}に needs なる, べく follows it, and {医学部|いがくぶ}を is the object of {目指|めざ}す.

en: Because of my youth, I made many mistakes.
why: ゆえに follows {若|わか}さ, then {失敗|しっぱい}も{多|おお}かった.

en: If it's for my children, I don't mind any hardship.
why: {子|こ}どもの modifies ため, とあれば follows it, and どんな modifies {苦労|くろう}.

after: {運動|うんどう}したほうがいい。
en: If not every day, you should exercise at least once a week.
why: とは{言|い}わないまでも is the set pattern, and {週|しゅう}に{一度|いちど} is one phrase.

before: この{仕事|しごと}を{任|まか}せられるのは、
en: There is no one but him I can trust with this job.
why: The pattern is noun + をおいて{他|ほか}に + negative.

en: I'm so busy I don't even have time to rest on weekends, let alone travel.
why: The pattern is noun + はおろか, then the smaller thing with も.

before: この{店|みせ}は{料理|りょうり}
en: At this shop, the food is good, and the staff's service is even better.
why: The pattern is noun + もさることながら, and {店員|てんいん}の modifies {接客|せっきゃく}.

before: {台風|たいふう}の{影響|えいきょう}で、
en: Because of the typhoon, the match was forced to be canceled.
why: The pattern is noun + を{余儀|よぎ}なくされる.

before: {彼|かれ}は{出張|しゅっちょう}
en: Using his business trip as an excuse, he does nothing but sightseeing.
why: The pattern is noun + にかこつけて, then {観光|かんこう}ばかりしている.

en: Undaunted by the heavy rain, they headed for the summit.
why: {激|はげ}しい modifies {雨|あめ}, then をものともせず, and {山頂|さんちょう}を is the object of {目指|めざ}した.

before: {彼|かれ}は{人|ひと}の{話|はなし}を
en: He tends not to listen to people until they finish.
why: {最後|さいご}まで goes before {聞|き}かない, and きらいがある follows the verb.

before: {息子|むすこ}は{遊|あそ}んでばかりで、
en: My son does nothing but play, and now he's even saying he'll quit university.
why: {大学|だいがく}を goes with {辞|や}める, と quotes it for {言|い}い{出|だ}す, and しまつだ follows the verb.

en: If it fails, I'll simply start over from scratch.
why: {一|いち}から goes with やり{直|なお}す, and the pattern is verb + までのことだ.

en: It's best not to take medicine if you can avoid it.
why: The pattern is verb + に{越|こ}したことはない.

en: You're not a child, so think for yourself.
why: The pattern is noun + ではあるまいし, then {自分|じぶん}で goes with {考|かんが}えなさい.

before: {簡単|かんたん}な{問題|もんだい}だ
en: I thought it was an easy problem, but it was surprisingly hard and took time.
why: と{思|おも}いきや follows the quote, and {意外|いがい}に modifies {難|むずか}しくて.

before: {今年|ことし}は{結婚|けっこん}や{昇進|しょうしん}など、
en: With my wedding and promotion, this year was full of good things.
why: いいこと is the noun, ずくめ follows it, and の links to {一年|いちねん}.

en: The children were playing, covered in mud.
why: まみれ follows {泥|どろ}, and になって links to {遊|あそ}んでいた.

en: This company released the new product ahead of other companies.
why: The pattern is noun + に{先駆|さきが}けて, and {新製品|しんせいひん}を is the object of {発売|はつばい}した.

en: Lateness is not accepted, whatever the reason.
why: {理由|りゆう}の modifies いかん, then によらず, then {遅刻|ちこく}は is the topic.
